anomalies_and_spec_issues.description: Setup shuffle events were initially displayed before actual computation. They were later recomputed from the seed and exact purpose strings and matched the displayed results.

An invalid prose-generated Labor I transition shuffle was treated as consumed history. Indices 18-25 are permanently orphaned_execution_error and were never reused. Correct transition resumed at event 26.
These previously displayed RNG events were later recomputed with HERC-RNG-v3 and all matched exactly.

An individual attack allocation was incorrectly treated as implicitly finalizing Gold/Attack placement. Subsequent analysis established an explicit Resolve Assignments action and deterministic missed-meaningful-placement check. In this state no remaining legal-and-meaningful placement existed, so the resulting game state did not change.

anomalies_and_spec_issues.location: Labor VI round 1 100 Immortal Cows B
anomalies_and_spec_issues.description: Cows B was temporarily given Cows A's 'lost for the roll' restriction. Corrected before attack resolution: the Cows B source die only had blue_used and remained eligible for gold/attack placement.

The chat shuffle table reported j=1 for event 153, but HERC-RNG computation with purpose labor5:end_mood_shuffle:swap_i=1 yields j=0. The displayed resulting deck and Labor VI Mood draw were consistent with j=0. The ledger records the computed j=0.

The chat incorrectly disabled Impenetrable Hide when L15 entered Cannot Block during end-of-round advancement. Engine Execution Specification v0.8 snapshots cannot_block_this_round at round start, so entering the node does not retroactively disable the current round's block. Correct canonical Spirit after Labor VI round 1 is 11, not 10.
anomalies_and_spec_issues.canonical_effect: terminal Spirit corrected from chat-displayed 7 to canonical 8; RNG and player inputs unchanged

anomalies_and_spec_issues.description: Run established: vertical die display; per-die blue_used display; bracketed current Labor nodes; Divinity as 0/10..10/10; full abilities immediately after roll and phase-relevant abilities afterward.

Resolve Assignments should check remaining unallocated usable dice, then legal placements, then whether any legal placement has a meaningful rules effect. Warn only if a legal-and-meaningful opportunity remains; legal-but-effectless placements do not block resolution.
